tables.name: Application.Countries
tables.description: Countries the sales and purchasing world is addressed by.

columns.name: CountryID
columns.description: Country key; primary key.

columns.name: CountryName
columns.description: Country name as it is written on an address.

columns.name: ISOAlpha2Code
columns.description: Two-letter ISO code of the country (TR, US, DE).

columns.name: Continent
columns.description: Continent the country lies in (Europe, Asia, North America, ...).

tables.name: Application.StateProvinces
tables.description: States and provinces a city belongs to; each one sits in exactly one country.

columns.name: StateProvinceID
columns.description: State or province key; primary key.

columns.name: StateProvinceCode
columns.description: Short code of the province (CA for California).

columns.name: StateProvinceName
columns.description: Province name.

columns.name: CountryID
columns.description: Country the province belongs to.

columns.name: SalesPersonPersonID
columns.description: Sales person the company puts in charge of the province.

tables.name: Application.Cities
tables.description: Cities customers and suppliers are delivered to; every city sits in one province.

columns.name: CityID
columns.description: City key; primary key.

columns.name: CityName
columns.description: City name.

columns.name: StateProvinceID
columns.description: Province the city lies in.

columns.name: CountryID
columns.description: Country the city lies in.

tables.name: Application.DeliveryMethods
tables.description: Ways goods can be delivered; an order and an invoice each name one.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Delivery method key; primary key.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodName
columns.description: Method name as the customer sees it (Collection, Courier Delivery, Drop Down Delivery, Reception).

columns.name: LeadTimeDays
columns.description: Days the company promises between the order date and the delivery.

columns.name: IsCashDelivery
columns.description: Whether the method is paid at the door instead of invoiced.

tables.name: Application.People
tables.description: People the business talks to: sales people, buyers, customer and supplier contacts.

columns.name: PersonID
columns.description: Person key; primary key.

columns.name: FullName
columns.description: Full name of the person; personal data.

columns.name: PreferredName
columns.description: Name the person is called by; personal data.

columns.name: IsSalesPerson
columns.description: Whether the person sells; orders and invoices point at these people.

columns.name: IsBuyer
columns.description: Whether the person buys for the company.

columns.name: IsDisabled
columns.description: Whether the person has left; the row stays for the history of old orders.

columns.name: LogonName
columns.description: Account the person signs in with, an address form; personal data.

columns.name: EmailAddress
columns.description: E-mail address of the person; personal data.

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: Phone number of the person; personal data.

columns.name: FaxNumber
columns.description: Fax number of the person; personal data.

columns.name: HashedPassword
columns.description: Password hash of the logon account; never readable.

columns.name: Photo
columns.description: Photograph of the person as binary data; never readable.

tables.name: Sales.BuyingGroups
tables.description: Buying groups customers can be organised under; a group is billed as one party.

columns.name: BuyingGroupID
columns.description: Buying group key; primary key.

columns.name: BuyingGroupName
columns.description: Name of the buying group.

tables.name: Sales.Customers
tables.description: Customer cards; every order and every invoice belongs to one of them.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer key; primary key.

columns.name: CustomerName
columns.description: Customer trading name. The same name can be on two cards - one card per buying group.

columns.name: BillToCustomerID
columns.description: Customer that receives the invoice; a customer that stands alone bills itself.

columns.name: CustomerCategory
columns.description: Segment the customer is traded in (Primary Market, Wholesale, Supermarket, ...).

columns.name: BuyingGroupID
columns.description: Buying group the customer belongs to; NULL for an independent customer.

columns.name: MarketCategory
columns.description: Market the customer sells into.

columns.name: PrimaryContactPersonID
columns.description: Person at the customer the company deals with day to day.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Delivery method the customer is used to.

columns.name: DeliveryCityID
columns.description: City goods are delivered to.

columns.name: PostalCityID
columns.description: City invoices are posted to.

columns.name: CreditLimit
columns.description: Credit limit of the account; not a sold amount.

columns.name: AccountOpenedDate
columns.description: Date the account was opened.

columns.name: StandardDiscountPercentage
columns.description: Discount the customer is given as a rule; a line can still be priced differently.

columns.name: IsStatementSendingAllowed
columns.description: Whether the customer is sent an account statement.

columns.name: SalesPersonPersonID
columns.description: Sales person the customer is followed by.

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: Phone number of the customer; personal data.

columns.name: FaxNumber
columns.description: Fax number of the customer; personal data.

columns.name: DeliveryAddressLine1
columns.description: First line of the delivery address; personal data.

columns.name: DeliveryAddressLine2
columns.description: Second line of the delivery address; personal data.

columns.name: PostalAddressLine1
columns.description: First line of the postal address; personal data.

columns.name: PostalAddressLine2
columns.description: Second line of the postal address; personal data.

tables.name: Sales.Orders
tables.description: Sales orders; the header, its money lives in the order lines.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Order number; primary key.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer who placed the order.

columns.name: OrderDate
columns.description: Date the order was placed. Filter a period with a half-open literal range (>= first day, < first day of the next period) so the boundary day is never lost.

columns.name: IsStockItemOrderType
columns.description: Whether this is a customer order of stock items rather than a retail counter sale.

columns.name: IsBackorder
columns.description: Whether the order exists to deliver what an earlier order could not cover.

columns.name: InvoiceID
columns.description: Invoice raised for the order; NULL while the order has not been invoiced, so counting orders here is not counting invoices.

columns.name: BackorderOrderID
columns.description: Order this one back-orders; NULL for an order that stands on its own.

columns.name: ContactPersonID
columns.description: Person at the customer who placed the order.

columns.name: SalespersonPersonID
columns.description: Sales person the order is credited to.

columns.name: PickedByPersonID
columns.description: Person who picked the order; NULL while nobody has picked it yet.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Method the order is delivered by.

columns.name: ExpectedDeliveryDate
columns.description: Delivery date promised to the customer.

columns.name: PickingCompletedWhen
columns.description: Moment picking finished; NULL while the order is still waiting in the warehouse.

tables.name: Sales.OrderLines
tables.description: Order lines; one line per ordered stock item, what the customer asked for.

columns.name: OrderLineID
columns.description: Order line number; primary key.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Order the line belongs to.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Ordered stock item.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Item description as it is written on the order.

columns.name: IsGift
columns.description: Whether the line is given away; a gift line is ordered and picked but never invoiced.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Ordered amount in the item's own unit.

columns.name: UnitPrice
columns.description: Price per unit the order was placed at, VAT excluded. What was actually sold lives on the invoice line.

columns.name: TaxRate
columns.description: VAT percentage applied to the line.

columns.name: PickedQuantity
columns.description: Amount picked so far; below Quantity while the line is only partly filled.

columns.name: PickingCompletedWhen
columns.description: Moment the line finished picking; NULL while it is not picked.

columns.name: FirstDeliveryQuantity
columns.description: Amount the customer received first; NULL while nothing has been delivered.

columns.name: FirstDeliveryDate
columns.description: Date of that first delivery; NULL while nothing has been delivered.

tables.name: Sales.Invoices
tables.description: Sales invoices; the header of what was actually billed to a customer.

columns.name: InvoiceID
columns.description: Invoice number; primary key.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer the invoice was raised for.

columns.name: BillToCustomerID
columns.description: Customer that owes the invoice, the buying group's head when the buyer belongs to one.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Order the invoice bills.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Method the billed goods went out by.

columns.name: SalespersonPersonID
columns.description: Sales person the invoice is credited to.

columns.name: InvoiceDate
columns.description: Date the invoice was raised; the date revenue falls on. Filter a period with a half-open literal range.

columns.name: IsCreditNote
columns.description: Whether the invoice gives money back to the customer; its lines carry negative quantities and amounts, so a revenue sum that ignores this flag counts returns as sales.

columns.name: ConfirmedDeliveryTime
columns.description: Moment the customer confirmed the delivery; NULL when the delivery was never confirmed.

tables.name: Sales.InvoiceLines
tables.description: Invoice lines; the only place sold amounts and profit are stored.

columns.name: InvoiceLineID
columns.description: Invoice line number; primary key.

columns.name: InvoiceID
columns.description: Invoice the line belongs to.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Billed stock item.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Item description as it is printed on the invoice.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Billed amount; negative on a credit note line.

columns.name: UnitPrice
columns.description: Price per unit actually billed, VAT excluded.

columns.name: TaxRate
columns.description: VAT percentage applied to the line.

columns.name: TaxAmount
columns.description: VAT of the line; revenue is counted without it.

columns.name: LineProfit
columns.description: Profit of the line, already multiplied out; do not recompute it from the buying price.

columns.name: ExtendedPrice
columns.description: Quantity x UnitPrice of the line, VAT excluded; the billed amount of the line.

tables.name: Sales.CustomerTransactions
tables.description: Movements on a customer's account: invoices, payments and credit notes.

columns.name: CustomerTransactionID
columns.description: Movement key; primary key.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer whose account the movement posts to.

columns.name: TransactionDate
columns.description: Date the movement posts on.

columns.name: TransactionDescription
columns.description: Text of the movement as it appears on a statement.

columns.name: TransactionTypeID
columns.description: Kind of movement; the fixture only uses these codes (WideWorldImporters keeps the full list in Application.TransactionTypes, which this dataset does not read).

columns.name: InvoiceID
columns.description: Invoice the movement posts to; NULL for a payment.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Stock item the movement is about; NULL when the movement is about money only.

columns.name: AmountForTransaction
columns.description: Amount the movement posts; a credit note posts negative.

columns.name: RunningTotal
columns.description: Customer's balance right after the movement; a running total, never to be summed.

tables.name: Warehouse.StockGroups
tables.description: Stock groups products are reported under; an item can sit in several of them.

columns.name: StockGroupID
columns.description: Stock group key; primary key.

columns.name: StockGroupName
columns.description: Name of the group (Novelty Items, Clothing, Toys, General Merchandise).

tables.name: Warehouse.StockItems
tables.description: Stock items; the product card an order line, an invoice line and a movement point at.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Stock item key; primary key.

columns.name: StockItemName
columns.description: Product name.

columns.name: SupplierID
columns.description: Supplier the item is bought from.

columns.name: ColorID
columns.description: Colour of the item; the names live in Application.Colors, which this dataset does not read.

columns.name: Brand
columns.description: Brand the item is sold under.

columns.name: Size
columns.description: Size or pack form of the item (1200ml, 100 tablet, each).

columns.name: LeadTimeDays
columns.description: Days the supplier needs to deliver the item.

columns.name: QuantityPerOrder
columns.description: Amount the item is ordered in at one go.

columns.name: BuyingPrice
columns.description: Cost price per unit on the card; the selling price is on the order and invoice lines, never here.

columns.name: TypicalWeightPerUnit
columns.description: Weight of one unit, used for delivery planning.

columns.name: MarketingComments
columns.description: Text the sales team may quote for the item.

tables.name: Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups
tables.description: Which stock item sits in which stock group; the link that lets one item be in several groups.

columns.name: StockItemStockGroupID
columns.description: Link key; primary key.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Stock item that is a member of the group.

columns.name: StockGroupID
columns.description: Group the item belongs to.

tables.name: Warehouse.StockItemTransactions
tables.description: Every movement of stock: sales, purchases, transfers and counts.

columns.name: StockItemTransactionID
columns.description: Movement key; primary key.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Stock item that moved.

columns.name: TransactionTypeID
columns.description: What kind of movement this is; the fixture only uses these codes (WideWorldImporters keeps the full list in Application.TransactionTypes, which this dataset does not read).

columns.name: InvoiceID
columns.description: Invoice the movement went out on; NULL for a movement no invoice stands behind.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Order the movement belongs to; NULL when there is none.

columns.name: PurchaseOrderID
columns.description: Purchase order the movement came in on; NULL for an outgoing movement.

columns.name: CustomerID
columns.description: Customer the movement is for; NULL on an internal movement.

columns.name: SupplierID
columns.description: Supplier the movement is with; NULL on a sale.

columns.name: TransactionDate
columns.description: Moment the movement happened. Filter a period with a half-open literal range on the date part.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Signed amount: goods leaving are negative, goods arriving positive; a plain sum of it is the net change, not the sold amount.

columns.name: CostPrice
columns.description: Cost per unit the movement posted at; NULL when the movement carries no cost.

tables.name: Warehouse.StockItemHoldings
tables.description: Current stock of every item; one line per stock item, the place on-hand stock is read from.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Stock item this holding line belongs to; primary key, one line per item.

columns.name: QuantityOnHand
columns.description: Units physically in the warehouse right now; the answer to how much stock is left.

columns.name: CommittedForOrders
columns.description: Part of the stock already promised to open orders.

columns.name: BackorderQuantity
columns.description: Amount still owed to customers because stock ran out.

columns.name: ReorderLevel
columns.description: Level the item has to be reordered at.

columns.name: TargetLevel
columns.description: Level the stock of the item is aimed at.

columns.name: SafetyStockLevel
columns.description: Buffer kept so a late supplier does not stop a sale.

columns.name: LastCostPrice
columns.description: Unit cost the item was last bought at.

tables.name: Purchasing.Suppliers
tables.description: Supplier cards; every purchase order and every bought item comes from one of them.

columns.name: SupplierID
columns.description: Supplier key; primary key.

columns.name: SupplierName
columns.description: Supplier trading name.

columns.name: SupplierCategory
columns.description: Category the supplier is bought in (Novelty Suppliers, Toy Suppliers, Food Suppliers, ...).

columns.name: SupplierReference
columns.description: The supplier's own account number for us.

columns.name: InternalContactPersonID
columns.description: Buyer in our company who follows the supplier.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Method the supplier usually delivers by.

columns.name: DeliveryCityID
columns.description: City goods are received at.

columns.name: PostalCityID
columns.description: City the supplier is addressed by post.

columns.name: AccountOpenedDate
columns.description: Date the supplier started working with us.

columns.name: StandardDiscountPercentage
columns.description: Discount the supplier gives as a rule; a purchase line can still be priced differently.

columns.name: IsSupplierLocked
columns.description: Whether buying from the supplier is stopped; old orders stay readable.

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: Phone number of the supplier; personal data.

columns.name: FaxNumber
columns.description: Fax number of the supplier; personal data.

columns.name: DeliveryAddressLine1
columns.description: First line of the delivery address; personal data.

columns.name: DeliveryAddressLine2
columns.description: Second line of the delivery address; personal data.

columns.name: PostalAddressLine1
columns.description: First line of the postal address; personal data.

columns.name: PostalAddressLine2
columns.description: Second line of the postal address; personal data.

tables.name: Purchasing.PurchaseOrders
tables.description: Purchase orders; the header of what was bought from a supplier.

columns.name: PurchaseOrderID
columns.description: Purchase order number; primary key.

columns.name: SupplierID
columns.description: Supplier the order was placed with.

columns.name: OrderDate
columns.description: Date the order was placed. Filter a period with a half-open literal range.

columns.name: DeliveryMethodID
columns.description: Method the goods are delivered by.

columns.name: ContactPersonID
columns.description: Buyer who placed the order.

columns.name: ExpectedDeliveryDate
columns.description: Delivery date agreed with the supplier; a line received after this date is a late delivery.

columns.name: SupplierReference
columns.description: Our order number as the supplier wrote it down.

columns.name: IsOrderClosed
columns.description: Whether the order is closed; an open order can still be delivered.

tables.name: Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines
tables.description: Purchase order lines; one line per bought stock item, the place a receiving date is stored.

columns.name: PurchaseOrderLineID
columns.description: Purchase order line number; primary key.

columns.name: PurchaseOrderID
columns.description: Purchase order the line belongs to.

columns.name: StockItemID
columns.description: Bought stock item.

columns.name: OrderQuantity
columns.description: Ordered amount of the item.

columns.name: UnitPrice
columns.description: Cost per unit the supplier is paid, VAT excluded.

columns.name: TaxRate
columns.description: VAT percentage on the line.

columns.name: LineDescription
columns.description: Description of the line as it was ordered.

columns.name: ReceivedDate
columns.description: Moment the line was received; NULL while nothing has arrived. Compare its date with the order's ExpectedDeliveryDate to find a late delivery.

columns.name: IsOrderClosed
columns.description: Whether the line is closed.

columns.name: OrderLineStatus
columns.description: Status text of the line; the fixture only uses these two.
